name: walk_talk
text: A person walks steadily forward talking to a companion on the left side. While continuing to walk, turns the head a little to the left and makes a conversational outward gesture with the left hand, then brings that hand down, natural relaxed movement.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.
